## Description {#details}

<p>A helper data structure to hold the operands of a vector of instructions.</p>


<p>This supports a fixed vector length for all operand vectors.</p>


<p>Definition at line 1988 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/slpvectorizer-cpp">SLPVectorizer.cpp</a>.</p>

### ReorderingMode {#a75123632e7d04bee5f5ae50f9c208bca}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel strong">strong</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>During operand reordering, we are trying to select the operand at lane that matches best with the operand at the neighboring lane.</p>

<dl class="doxyEnumList">
<dt class="doxyEnumTableTitle">Enumeration values</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyEnumTable">

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">Load<a id="a75123632e7d04bee5f5ae50f9c208bcaaf19dbf2edb3a0bd74b0524d960ff21eb"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription">Matching loads to consecutive memory addresses</td>
</tr>

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">Opcode<a id="a75123632e7d04bee5f5ae50f9c208bcaa5782f6bdd633ac305e1e625779f96a77"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription">Matching instructions based on opcode (same or alternate)</td>
</tr>

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">Constant<a id="a75123632e7d04bee5f5ae50f9c208bcaacb17869fe51048b5a5c4c6106551a255"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription">Matching constants</td>
</tr>

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">Splat<a id="a75123632e7d04bee5f5ae50f9c208bcaa5b9bf50c6579a978e5c1104bf8787651"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription">Matching the same instruction multiple times (broadcast)</td>
</tr>

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">Failed<a id="a75123632e7d04bee5f5ae50f9c208bcaad7c8c85bf79bbe1b7188497c32c3b0ca"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription">We failed to create a vectorizable group</td>
</tr>

</table>
</dd>
</dl>


<p>Our selection is based on the type of value we are looking for. For example, if the neighboring lane has a load, we need to look for a load that is accessing a consecutive address. These strategies are summarized in the 'ReorderingMode' enumerator.</p>


<p>Definition at line 2036 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/slpvectorizer-cpp">SLPVectorizer.cpp</a>.</p>
